fields.name: userId
fields.description: IAM user id (OIDC sub) this config belongs to. One row per user; the read+write hooks filter by currentUser.id so only the owner reads/writes.

fields.name: provider
fields.description: Provider id: 'anthropic' (default) or 'openai'. Empty/missing is treated as 'anthropic' by the proxy. Maps to the `x-ai-chat-provider` request header on `/api/ai/chat`.

fields.name: gatewayUrl
fields.description: Override for AI_GATEWAY_URL / ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL. For Anthropic, the Messages API base (e.g. https://api.anthropic.com). For OpenAI, the Chat Completions base (e.g. https://api.openai.com/v1). Empty string means 'use server default'.

fields.name: model
fields.description: Override for AI_GATEWAY_MODEL / ANTHROPIC_MODEL. Empty string means 'use server default'.

fields.name: token
fields.description: Override for AI_GATEWAY_TOKEN / ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN. Empty string means 'use server default'. Marked PII because it is a credential.
